summary: Join our course on performance measurement and management in the public sector. Learn strategies to improve efficiency and accountability in your organization.
lede: Public sector performance management training helps policy and programme teams turn priorities into measurable service and programme results. Designed for analysts, programme managers, monitoring and evaluation officers, and service leaders, it develops skills in translating priorities into results chains, selecting and documenting meaningful indicators, and using data reviews to plan corrective action, with frameworks such as Results-Based Management and Theory of Change supporting evidence-based decisions.
audienceIntro: This public sector performance course is designed for professionals who translate public policy, budgets, and service commitments into measurable delivery results.
modules: Theory of Change and Outcome Design
prerequisites: No formal qualification is required. You should have practical exposure to public policy, programme delivery, public finance, monitoring and evaluation, service operations, or organizational reporting. Basic spreadsheet use is helpful, but coding is not required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted dashboard concepts are taught at conceptual and operational application level; the course does not teach production software engineering or enterprise system implementation.
